title: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering

entities.name: Oriel Kjeldos
entities.description: A shaman and head of Clan Emerald who urges Storgard's council to flee south; the city of Kjeldor is named for her descendants.

entities.name: Jason Carthalion
entities.description: Oriel's young champion and Freyalise's childhood friend, who mortally wounds her in a duel orchestrated by Tevesh Szat.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: A powerful mage of Clan Ruby who becomes a planeswalker, and who casts the World Spell to end the Ice Age.

entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: A demonic planeswalker who secretly advises King Miko and works to silence Dominaria, destroying Storgard and later fighting Jaeuhl.

entities.name: King Miko
entities.description: The king of Storgard, secretly advised by Tevesh Szat.

entities.name: Storgard
entities.description: The glacier kingdom and last stronghold of civilization in Terisiare, destroyed when the glacier crashed down; its ruins are later called Soldev.

entities.name: Zilgeth
entities.description: A wizard of Clan Ruby who dies casting Incineration against a Johtull Wurm.

entities.name: Hurn
entities.description: Storgard's Master-at-Arms of Clan Pearl and husband of Mariska.

entities.name: Mariska
entities.description: Hurn's wife who provides Jason and Freyalise with magical items.

entities.name: Kjeldor
entities.description: The marble-spired city founded for the descendants of Oriel Kjeldos five hundred years after Storgard's fall.

entities.name: Darien Kjeld
entities.description: The prince of Kjeldor who sends knights to aid the nomads of Balduvia.

entities.name: Sir Zaraya
entities.description: Darien's finest knight, who leads the Balduvia mission and later hands the Nova Pentacle to Freyalise.

entities.name: Kailo
entities.description: A one-eyed, one-handed tracker and Zaraya's former lover whose son Severin died under her command.

entities.name: Bolar
entities.description: A shaman of the Knights of Kjeldor with an extra pair of tiny arms.

entities.name: Onala
entities.description: A knight of royal blood who resigns from the Order after losing Gregor.

entities.name: Sir Gregor
entities.description: Onala's lover, killed by Lim-Dul's zombies.

entities.name: Xian
entities.description: A Kjeldoran knight who recognizes the Nova Pentacle.

entities.name: Lim-Dul
entities.description: A former Knight of Kjeldor turned necromancer and Leshrac's minion who raises undead against the knights.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: A planeswalker who is Lim-Dul's master and conspirator with Faralyn and Szat.

entities.name: Samiks
entities.description: A dying warrior of the Marked Ones who gifts Zaraya a Nova Pentacle.

entities.name: Marked Ones
entities.description: A Balduvian nomad tribe destroyed in part by Lim-Dul and healed by Bolar's salve.

entities.name: Nova Pentacle
entities.description: An ancient relic of untold power, given by Samiks to Zaraya and later by Zaraya to Freyalise for Jaeuhl.

entities.name: Faralyn
entities.description: A planeswalker who hosts the Summit of the Null Moon and secretly seeks to escape the Shard of the Twelve Worlds.

entities.name: Shard of the Twelve Worlds
entities.description: A formation of twelve worlds in which the planeswalkers are trapped.

entities.name: Null Moon
entities.description: A constructed moon of Dominaria where the Summit of the Null Moon takes place.

entities.name: Kristina of the Woods
entities.description: A planeswalker invited to the Summit who resurrects Ravidel.

entities.name: Taysir of Rabiah
entities.description: A planeswalker invited to the Summit who urges caution.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: Faralyn's spellsquire and friend of Chromium Rhuell, killed by Leshrac and resurrected.

entities.name: Chromium Rhuell
entities.description: An elder chromium dragon killed by Szat's Dark Banishing at the Summit.

entities.name: Shandalar
entities.description: A mana-rich rogue plane the conspirators intend to conquer.

entities.name: Jaeuhl Carthalion
entities.description: The worst knight of Kjeldor, a Carthalion descendant who defeats Szat with the Amulet of Quoz.

entities.name: Kaysa
entities.description: A child of Kelsinko bearing the Mark of the Elder Druid, whose essence powers the World Spell.

entities.name: Amulet of Quoz
entities.description: A relic in the ruins of Soldev, tossed by Jaeuhl to defeat Szat.

entities.name: World Spell
entities.description: Freyalise's greatest spell that breaks the enchantments causing the Ice Age.

entities.name: Ice Age
entities.description: The long freeze of Dominaria, magical in origin, ended by the World Spell.

entities.name: Priest of Yawgmoth
entities.description: A Phyrexian priest summoned by Szat to recover and consecrate Storgard's artifacts.

entities.name: Arimaya
entities.description: Oriel's younger sister, of Clan Onyx, a member of the Stone Council.

events.summary: Oriel Kjeldos flees a Johtull Wurm; Zilgeth dies casting Incineration to kill it.
events.quote: Zilgeth casts an Incineration spell which kills the wurm but also costs him his life.

events.summary: Oriel urges the Stone Council to leave Storgard, but they accuse her of blasphemy.
events.quote: As head of Clan Emerald , she urges the council to leave Storgard and bring their people to the south.

events.summary: Tevesh Szat warns Miko that Clan Emerald plots against him.
events.quote: Szat warns Miko that Clan Emerald plots against him

events.summary: An explosion in Clan Emerald's quarters kills sixteen; Miko decrees a duel to the death between Jason and Freyalise.
events.quote: But Miko decrees that a magical duel must decide the conflict.

events.summary: Jason and Freyalise duel; Szat's wind drops them on the Bridge of Hielos and the glacier crashes down on Storgard.
events.quote: Neither mage pauses to notice that the folly of their conflict has forced the glacier to come crashing down on the castle.

events.summary: Jason, influenced by Szat, uses black mana and mortally wounds Freyalise, then rejects the demon's temptation.
events.quote: Jason shoots the Fyndhorn Bow and wounds her mortally.

events.summary: Freyalise forgives Jason and hopes to ascend.
events.quote: She hopes to ascend and will turn to green mana in honor of her childhood friend.

events.summary: Forty days later Miko lets the Emerald and Pearl clans leave and Jason's group heads south.
events.quote: Jason, Oriel, Mariska, Hurn, and four dozen other people start their walk to the south.

events.summary: Darien sends Sir Zaraya and the finest knights to Balduvia in answer to a nomad plea.
events.quote: He summons Sir Zaraya and orders her to collect the finest Knights of Kjeldor and to travel to Balduvia .

events.summary: Lim-Dul intercepts the Erne and raises undead legions from a frozen swamp.
events.quote: he raises his undead legions from a frozen swamp

events.summary: Lim-Dul's zombies kill Sir Gregor while Onala is paralyzed by visions.
events.quote: Gregor is killed by the zombies

events.summary: Samiks dies, giving Zaraya a Nova Pentacle.
events.quote: In his dying breath, Samiks gifts his last relic to Zaraya.

events.summary: Leshrac transforms Lim-Dul with the Master of the Hunt spell.
events.quote: Leshrac casts the Master of the Hunt spell on Lim-Dûl, transforming him into a mighty creature.

events.summary: The knights defeat Lim-Dul with the Winds of Kataba and Word of Undoing; Leshrac leaves him in an Icy Prison.
events.quote: Leshrac is not pleased and leaves Lim-Dûl stuck in an Icy Prison

events.summary: Onala resigns from the Order and Zaraya and Kailo reconcile over their son's death.
events.quote: Onaya resigns from the Order.

events.summary: Faralyn hosts the Summit of the Null Moon with the planeswalkers trapped in the Shard.
events.quote: For ten centuries, they have been trapped within a tiny formation of twelve worlds

events.summary: Szat kills Chromium Rhuell with Dark Banishing and combat breaks out.
events.quote: Szat follows through with Dark Banishing , killing the mighty dragon.

events.summary: Szat reveals he is in league with Faralyn and Leshrac and plans to silence Dominaria.
events.quote: He reveals that he was in league with Faralyn and Leshrac all along

events.summary: Szat's Soul Burn gravely injures Freyalise before he flees.
events.quote: injuring Freyalise horribly before he flees from the duel

events.summary: Faralyn uses Rhuell's death energy to open the rift; Lim-Dul escapes and Leshrac kills Ravidel with Fire Covenant.
events.quote: Leshrac casts Fire Covenant , bringing fiery harm to all present and killing Ravidel.

events.summary: Kristina and Taysir resurrect Ravidel, who declares Kristina his enemy.
events.quote: He doesn't agree with Kristina changing his fate and declares her his enemy forever.

events.summary: Szat's Priest of Yawgmoth plots to unleash a killing cold on Dominaria from the ruins of Storgard.
events.quote: he wants to unleash a coldness with blue mana that will kill all living things on Dominaria

events.summary: Freyalise, disguised, convinces Zaraya to hand over the Nova Pentacle and prophesizes Jaeuhl as champion.
events.quote: Prophesizing that Jaeuhl will be the champion in the final battle

events.summary: Freyalise charges Jaeuhl to defeat Szat and arms him.
events.quote: She asks Jaeul to slay the demon or to banish him from Dominaria.

events.summary: Freyalise asks Kaysa to help cast her greatest spell, admitting she cannot guarantee the child's safety.
events.quote: Freyalise, revealing her blind eyes, admits that she can not.

events.summary: Szat attacks Jaeuhl in the ruins of Soldev and an Icequake begins.
events.quote: an Icequake starts, and to Szat's glee, the temperature begins to drop significantly

events.summary: Jaeuhl finds the Amulet of Quoz and the Nova Pentacle reflects the Priest's shield.
events.quote: The Nova Pentacle that Jaeuhl still wears reflects the shield and sends the Priest away instead.

events.summary: Jaeuhl tosses the Amulet of Quoz and defeats Szat.
events.quote: the Amulet falls head's up and grants Jaeuhl victory. Szat is defeated.

events.summary: Freyalise unleashes the World Spell, breaking the enchantments that caused the Ice Age.
events.quote: Taysir and Kristina witness the breaking of the enchantments that caused the Ice Age.

events.summary: Szat and Lim-Dul escape through a portal to Shandalar.
events.quote: a portal opens up to transport Szat and Lim-Dûl to Shandalar
